principle: No business-data hardcoding. Routing and rendering decisions are based on semantic intent, conversation context, canonical bank reconciliation data and table metadata.
changes: Bank-event semantic router prioritizes event_bank / Cuadre Banco over general account history
event_bank now exposes reconciliation_timeline with movement, cumulative impact, bank-period balance, concept and evidence
event_bank_timeline is redirected unless historical account chronology is explicitly requested
Chart-refinement follow-ups inherit chart intent beyond simple affirmative replies
Chart turns that contain no current tool call are forced through a data-retrieval round
Canonical bank reconciliation line chart prioritizes reconciliation_timeline
Backend emits static pointLabels and pointTooltips for PDF-safe line charts
Frontend line renderer provides a segmented static-label PDF mode for dense bank series
Auditor rejects answers that delegate chart rendering to another ControlEvent layer
